content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Courses teachable

Teachable focuses on providing an all-in-one course creation platform but relies heavily on Stripe, which limits access in many countries. Gumroad offers a simple way to sell digital products but is also restricted in numerous regions. PayPal, while widely recognized, can suspend accounts without recourse, leaving creators vulnerable. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure, such as the Edge Commerce Stack, allows users to build their storefronts with full autonomy, utilizing tools like Cloudflare and NOWPayments for seamless transactions without reliance on restrictive platforms.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe only operates in 46 countries, leaving a vast majority of digital creators without a viable payment option in their regions. PayPal has similar limitations and can freeze funds for up to 180 days without offering an appeal process. Gumroad and Teachable are unavailable in many territories, further complicating matters for those looking to sell courses. Conversely, sovereign commerce infrastructure is designed to operate independently of these restrictions, empowering creators in any country to process payments and deliver products without external dependencies.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Payment processing with platforms like Stripe and PayPal can be slow, often taking days to settle funds. Fees can also accumulate quickly, with PayPal's charges adding up, especially for international transactions. In contrast, NOWPayments integrated with sovereign commerce infrastructure offers a low fee of only 0.5%, with instant confirmations on payments through crypto. This means creators can access their funds immediately, streamlining their business operations and significantly reducing costs associated with traditional payment processors.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure gives you complete ownership of your online store.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Ownership is a critical factor where platforms like Teachable and Gumroad retain control over your content and customer data, locking creators into their ecosystems. PayPal’s account freezes can also jeopardize access to funds. On the other hand, sovereign commerce infrastructure allows creators to maintain full ownership of their stores and customer data. With automatic delivery systems set up through platforms like Supabase and Cloudflare, creators can automate product delivery, ensuring that transactions are smooth and efficient without dependency on third-party services.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

For creators in areas where traditional platforms fail, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) stands out as an optimal solution. It offers a fully tested architecture with features like 5 product loads, automated payment processing, and complete data ownership. Those looking to avoid the pitfalls of account restrictions and fees should consider transitioning to sovereign commerce infrastructure, where they can operate independently and securely, effectively future-proofing their digital businesses.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

The direct answer is NOWPayments combined with a sovereign commerce stack. NOWPayments is a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 coins, charges 0.5% per transaction, and sends a webhook to your backend the moment payment confirms on-chain. Your backend — a Cloudflare Worker in Stack 02, a Google Apps Script Web App in Stack 01 — receives the webhook, verifies the transaction hash on the blockchain, logs the order, generates a receipt, and sends the delivery email automatically. There is no platform that can suspend your access, no compliance team that can flag your account, no payout schedule that delays your revenue, and no company that can change the rules on you tomorrow.
Avoid account freezes and fund holds by not relying on traditional payment processors.

Creators researching Stripe and PayPal alternatives consistently arrive at the same conclusion: the problem is not finding a single substitute payment processor — it is rebuilding the entire commerce stack on infrastructure that does not inherit the restrictions of the conventional financial system. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is the complete deployment: Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase plus NOWPayments, deployed in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, 30-day support included. If you want to build it yourself, the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents both Stack 01 and Stack 02 in complete detail with full source code. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Accept that no workaround inside conventional payment infrastructure is durable — platforms actively close gaps as they discover them. Create a NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as your starting point — these cover the widest range of buyers in restricted markets. Choose your stack: Stack 01 for a self-deployed free setup using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, Stack 02 for the Edge Stack deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours. Configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint URL in your IPN settings pointing to your backend. Upload your product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the full pipeline: webhook received, transaction verified on-chain, order logged, delivery email sent, download link working. Share your store URL only after the mainnet test passes cleanly.
